title: "Fankai Dai"

My name is Fankai Dai. I am a PhD student in Journalism at The University of Hong Kong.

Previously, I obtained my B.A. degree from college of media and international culture at Zhejiang University and M.A. degree from school of Journalism and Communication at Tsinghua University. I also worked as a journalism intern at Caixin media, the paper.
